a_fourth_thing_the_reading_got_wrong.and_the_check_that_it_only_added: re-run over all ten companies: zero positions that previously matched moved, exactly two became MATCH, and only Pfizer used the reconstruction. A change that moved an existing reading would be a change to the reading's rule, not an extension of its reach.
a_fourth_thing_the_reading_got_wrong.the_branch_no_filing_in_this_set_exercis: the CostsAndExpenses cross-check. It is implemented because the definition requires it, and no filing here both omits OperatingIncomeLoss and tags CostsAndExpenses, so nothing in this set would notice if it were wrong.
a_fourth_thing_the_reading_got_wrong.what: Pfizer's B03 and B07 read as NOT_READ, and the reason was in the reading, not the filing.

what_the_filing_states.CostsAndExpenses: not tagged, so the cross-check does not apply here

a_fourth_thing_the_reading_got_wrong.why: both depend on operating income and Pfizer tags no OperatingIncomeLoss at all - zero occurrences in a 5.2 MB primary document. The reading stopped at the first candidate; the approved definition does not. It allows pretax continuing income less an AGGREGATE nonoperating bridge, and requires Revenues - CostsAndExpenses to cross-check the reconstruction where the filer tags CostsAndExpenses.

fault_injections_on_the_operating_income.why_here: this is the one place the reading computes a number the filing does not state, so it is the one place a wrong rule answers confidently.

the_one_apparent_defect_that_was_not.and_it_put_a_claim_of_mine_in_question: the first acceptance entry for Marriott's B03 said the combined D&A chain has no fact 'in this filing', which was measured over the primary document only. Checked against the accession's facts: Marriott reports neither DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization nor DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet nor DepreciationAndAmortization, only Depreciation 145,000,000 and AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets 313,000,000. So the composition fallback is right and the entry stands - but it stood on the wrong universe until this was run.
the_one_apparent_defect_that_was_not.what_changed_because_of_it: the reading now checks, before reporting a difference, whether an earlier chain candidate exists in the accession at all. A limit of the reading and a defect in the route are different findings and only one of them is about the repository.
the_one_apparent_defect_that_was_not.what_it_was: the primary document's inline XBRL is a subset of the accession's facts. It tags DepreciationAndAmortization (3,631,000,000) and not DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization, which is first in the approved chain; the accession's own facts carry that one at 1,200,000,000, and that is what the route used. The route followed the definition and the reading could not.

two_things_my_own_reading_got_wrong_firs.and_a_third_that_was_only_a_comparison: Ford's B03 first read as DIFFERS because Decimal kept a trailing zero and I compared strings. Numbers are compared as numbers now.
two_things_my_own_reading_got_wrong_firs.the_document_path: built from company_id, which is 'macys' while the saved directory is 'macy_s'. Nine of ten worked and the tenth was reported as an unsaved filing. The path now comes from the input's own source_repo_relative_path.
two_things_my_own_reading_got_wrong_firs.the_instant_key: an instant context has no start date, so its facts are stored under a key with None there. Looking them up under (end, end, True) found nothing - for every company - and B08 and B09 read as NOT_READ everywhere. A reading that finds nothing looks exactly like a filing that says nothing.

what_the_injections_check.LET_AN_ACCEPTANCE_OVERRIDE_A_WITHDRAWAL: when the two registers disagree about a result, the withdrawal is the safer of the two. Caught by its own case.
what_the_injections_check.MATCH_THE_COORDINATE_AND_IGNORE_THE_VALU: the natural way to write this layer, and the way that lets a later Run inherit a reading nobody did. Caught by the case that changes one digit.

what_this_is: eight statement metrics read out of each company's own 10-K by tools/read_statement_facts.py, and compared to what the route published. The route resolves them from the Company Facts API; this walks the filing's primary document.
